Unfortunately, I had a bad experience with the pet grooming service. The service left much to be desired. My daughter booked a bath and grooming appointment for our pet, but when I arrived at the location, it was closed on Saturday at 4 pm. A total disregard for the customer; they could have informed us or even not scheduled the service at all.

I live in Saúde, but all the pet shops I've taken my dog ​​to haven't done a very good job of cutting her hair. She's a Lhasa Apso, which we adopted 11 months ago. I decided to travel further to understand if it's the area or if I'm just not explaining things properly.
I went at the last minute, on a Friday, after a quick search and already knowing that there might not be any available appointments. And there weren't, but they squeezed me in at 9:30 am.
The place was super clean, well decorated, we were well attended to, and I explained with photos what I was expecting.
After 2 hours, a pleasant surprise. The puppy was beautiful! It met my expectations.
I love Lucas's grooming, the best groomer I've ever taken my Spitz to, he always leaves it exactly how I ask/like it. I highly recommend him!
